entities.summary: Hekhalot literature, from the Hebrew word for "Palaces," relates to visions of entering heaven alive. The genre overlaps with Merkabah mysticism, also called "Chariot literature", which concerns Ezekiel's vision of the throne-chariot, so the two are sometimes referred to as the "Books of the Palaces and the Chariot". Hekhalot literature is a genre of Jewish esoteric and revelatory texts produced sometime between late antiquity to the Early Middle Ages.
